xna-type.name: ModelMeshPart
xna-type.summary: Represents a batch of geometry information to submit to the graphics device during rendering. Each ModelMeshPart is a subdivision of a ModelMesh object. The ModelMesh class is split into multiple ModelMeshPart objects, typically based on material information.
xna-type.remarks: It is not necessary to use this class directly. In advanced rendering scenarios, it is possible to draw using ModelMeshPart properties in combination with the vertex and index buffers on ModelMesh . However, in most cases, ModelMesh.Draw will be sufficient.

property.name: BaseVertex
property.summary: Gets the offset to add to each vertex index in the index buffer.

property.name: Effect
property.summary: Gets or sets the material Effect for this mesh part.
property.remarks: ModelMesh.Effects is a shortcut for iterating over the MeshParts property of the ModelMesh and looking up the ModelMeshPart.Effect property of each ModelMeshPart . ModelMesh.Effects is a collection of all the Effect properties of the for the MeshParts of this ModelMesh . Each ModelMeshPart has a single Effect which is a reference to one of the Effects of the parent ModelMesh property. By updating all the effects of the ModelMesh all of the effects of each ModelMeshPart are updated as well.

property.name: IndexBuffer
property.summary: Gets the index buffer for this mesh part.

property.name: NumVertices
property.summary: Gets the number of vertices used during a draw call.

property.name: PrimitiveCount
property.summary: Gets the number of primitives to render.

property.name: StartIndex
property.summary: Gets the location in the index array at which to start reading vertices.

property.name: StreamOffset
property.summary: Gets the offset in bytes from the beginning of the VertexBuffer.

property.name: Tag
property.summary: Gets or sets an object identifying this model mesh part.

property.name: VertexBuffer
property.summary: Gets the vertex buffer for this mesh part.

property.name: VertexDeclaration
property.summary: Gets the vertex declaration for this model mesh part.

property.name: VertexOffset
property.summary: Gets the offset (in vertices) from the top of vertex buffer.

property.name: VertexStride
property.summary: Gets the size, in bytes, of the elements in this vertex stream.
